<subject>Re: Updated Guarantee Document</subject>
<body>
Most of the language in this document already appears in the guarantee as waivers—I’m fine with stating the same points in two different ways if it helps move the transaction along. Any concerns?

---------------------- Forwarded by Mark Stevens/Tasman Ridge on 15/04/2024 02:15 PM ---------------------------

Michael_Brown@ozminerals.com.au on 12/04/2024 04:45 PM
To: Mark.Stevens@tasmanridge.com.au
cc: Emily.Clark@tasmanridge.com.au, David.Wilson@tasmanridge.com.au, 
Paul_Hart@ozminerals.com.au, Linda_Moore@ozminerals.com.au

Subject: Re: Updated Guarantee Document

The revised Guarantee looks acceptable, except I would prefer the opening sentence of Section 1 to read as follows:

 Subject to the provisions herein, the Guarantor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantees the prompt payment when due of the obligations (including, without limitation, all renewals, extensions, and modifications thereof, plus all interest, fees, and other monetary charges incurred or accrued during the course of any bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, or similar proceeding, regardless of whether allowed or allowable in such proceeding) of Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to OzMinerals under the Loan Documents (the "Obligations").

Please advise on the status of the Credit Agreement. Are you currently drafting that document?

Mark.Stevens@tasmanridge.com.au on 12/04/2024 10:30 AM
To: Michael Brown, Sara.Hughes@tasmanridge.com.au, Emily.Clark@tasmanridge.com.au, David.Wilson@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Updated Guarantee Document

I have attempted to incorporate the feedback from our recent call. Note that some of the rephrasing in the introductory paragraph is to align with documentation currently being prepared by our derivatives team, which will be circulated shortly.

(See attached files: Guarantee_TasmanRidge_v3.doc, Guarantee_TasmanRidge_v3_redlined.doc)

 - Guarantee_TasmanRidge_v3.doc
 - Guarantee_TasmanRidge_v3_redlined.doc
</body>
